   HUMAN EQUITY, ACCESS AND RELATIONS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Tuesday, September 28, 2021

 Purpose of the Commission: The purpose of the HEAR Commission is to advance and
 advocate for equity, access, diversity, social justice, safety, mutual appreciation,
 increased cultural competency, positive inter-group relations and respect for all
 members of the San Gabriel community (the “Purpose”).

   MINUTES OF THURSDAY, AUGUST 26, 2021
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  HUMAN EQUITY, ACCESS, AND RELATIONS (HEAR) COMMISSION

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Jennings-Nuñez called the special meeting of the HEAR Commission to order at 6:34 p.m.
on Thursday August 26, 2021 with all Commissioners and staff participating by teleconference.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Borja.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present:  Jacqueline Borja, Michelle Brenhaug, Susan Fitzsimmons, Viki Goto,
  Jorge Herrera, Riaz (Rick) Khan and Chasity Jennings-Nuñez
Commissioners Absent:  None

ANNOUNCMENTS

Recreation Supervisor Matthew Morales-Stevens provided information for the public on how to
submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas. If you wish to address the HEAR
Commission, e-mail all public comments to mmoralesstevens@sgch.org.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Hearing no objection, Chair Jennings-Nuñez announced the agenda order was approved.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

  3. ACTION ITEMS

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

HEAR COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  AUGUST 26, 2021
   A motion was made by Commissioner Brenhaug, seconded by Commissioner Borja
  to approve the minutes of the HEAR Commission Regular Meeting for July 27, 2021.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 7-0-0 as follows:
  Ayes: Borja, Brenhaug, Fitzsimmons, Goto, Khan, Herrera, Jennings-Nuñez
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None

  4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. GUEST SPEAKER- DANI ANDERSON

  Ms. Anderson provided a community education presentation surrounding
  disability pride and culture, the Independent Living Movement, and improving
  communication between individuals with and without disabilities including
  attitudinal barriers and language use.

  Public Comment: None

  B. DISCUSSION OF THE ANNUAL WORKPLAN AND ACTION PLAN

  The Annual Workplan was approved with amendments at the June 15 City Council
  meeting. Commissioners discussed progress made on each item. Primary items
  discussed at this meeting included Community Engagement, Youth Engagement
  and Partnerships.

  Commissioner Borja provided an update on the research she has done related to
  the addition of a Youth Liaison to the Commission, resources that are available for
  youth in the City and the development of a survey.

  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor, provided an update on the
  creation of a celebration for the Native American Heritage Month, including
  conversations with local tribal leaders.

  Staff were directed to provide samples of surveys that the Community Services
  department has used in the past and provide an outline for the selection of a youth
  liaison.

  Commissioner Borja volunteered to assist Commissioner Goto to develop
  questions for the youth survey.

  Commissioners to send staff speaker recommendations for future meetings.

HEAR COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  AUGUST 26, 2021
   Public Comment: San Gabriel Community Services Commissioner, Bronwyn Stuart-
  Velazquez commented about looking forward to working with the H.E.A.R.
  Commission on future community events.

  C. LAND ACKNOWLEDGMENT STATEMENT

  Staff discussed updates on the development of the Land Acknowledgment
  Statement, including the decision from City Council regarding the development of
  a Land Acknowledgement Statement Advisory Committee with the addition of two
  Council Liaisons.

  Public Comment: None

  Staff recommended that the HEAR Commission appoint two commissioners to
  serve on the Land Acknowledgement Statement Advisory Committee.

  Commissioner Borja nominated Chair Jennings-Nuñez and Commissioner
  Brenhaug nominated herself. Hearing no other nominations Chair Jennings-Nuñez
  closed the floor to nominations and declared both herself, Chair Jennings-Nuñez
  and Commissioner Brenhaug Land Acknowledgement Statement Advisory
  Committee Members.

  5. COMMISIONER COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Vice-Chair Hererra shared a quote by Steve Krug, “The one argument for accessibility that
  doesn’t get made nearly often enough is how extraordinarily better it makes some
  people’s lives. How many opportunities do we have to dramatically improve people’s lives
  just by doing our job a little better?” Vice-Chair Herrera shared the importance of the HEAR
  Commission and the impact that it is making on the community.

  Commissioner Fitzsimmons shared information she had related to the fiscal state of the
  City and urged the Commission to keep this is mind as they plan programs or events in
  the workplan.

  Chair Jennings reminded Commissioners and community members to be active in their
  local government. She also provided a reminder of the upcoming election.

  6. STAFF COMMENTS

  Mark Lazzaretto, City Manager, stated that at the September 7 City Council meeting the
  Council will be considering an item for translation of agendas from English into Spanish,
  Chinese and Vietnamese. The item will include costs associated to the translation of the
  Council and HEAR Commission agendas.

HEAR COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  AUGUST 26, 2021
   7. ADJOURNMENT
  Chair Jennings-Nuñez adjourned the meeting at 8:07 p.m.
